D: An average army librarian wakes up 500 years in the future to find he is now the smartest man alive.
P: Serve the drink when the electrolytes come up.
S: Mixed corn chips, pretzels and cheese puffs in a huge bowl. Tip 200g corn chips, 150g pretzels and 150g cheese puffs into a huge bowl.
Seasoned fries with chicken salt. Bake 1kg frozen chips at 220C for 25 minutes and toss with chicken salt.
M: Joe teaching them to water the crops
A big fresh salad bowl with grilled chicken, because plants actually need water. Grill 600g chicken breast and slice.

s.how: Tip 200g corn chips, 150g pretzels and 150g cheese puffs into a huge bowl. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.
Bake 1kg frozen chips at 220C for 25 minutes and toss with chicken salt. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: Joe teaching them to water the crops
m.how: Grill 600g chicken breast and slice. Toss with salad leaves, 2 tomatoes, 1 cucumber and avocado and dress with oil and lemon. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.how: Bake 12 vanilla cupcakes and ice with buttercream tinted blue. Serve it at the halfway point of the film. Leave it out for anyone who wants seconds.

d.how: Mix the juice of 3 oranges and 2 lemons with 3 tbsp honey, a pinch of salt and 1L cold water. Serve over ice. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
